---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest new mods, gameplay features, or improvements for Surviving The Spiral.
title: "[Suggestion]"
labels: Suggestion
assignees: BrianTornado

---

### What would you like to see added or improved?
Describe your idea.

### Why would this be useful?
Explain how it could improve Surviving The Spiral.

### Suggested mod or feature
If you have a specific mod or feature in mind, include its name and a link if available.

### How would it fit the modpack?
Would it improve weather, survival, exploration, building, aviation, quality of life, or another aspect?

### Additional details
Include examples, screenshots, links, or other information that helps explain your idea.

### Before submitting
- Check whether this suggestion has already been reported.
- Remember that suggestions may not be added if they conflict with the modpack's goals or compatibility requirements.
